verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pilot publishes an llms.txt at pilot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent has an entry point. The visible content is only a short entity and category descriptor, and the markdown doc variant (faq.md) returns 404, so agent-oriented documentation beyond that stub is thin. Missing for 10: substantive llms.txt content linking to docs, markdown versions of doc pages, agent-oriented API/docs (no OpenAPI spec found), any first-party documentation or independent corroboration of agent use.
